title: For You
author: Boby Borah
text:
I can wait for you
Secretly behind shadows,
A fresh wind may
Tell me in a whisper
The message of your arrival.
Blue sky may watch
With envious eyes,
An intimate silhouette`ll reflect
In the smiles of green.

I may recite a poem
In noon too for you,
Putting eye to eye on you
I can tell a tale of
Witching hour.
In deep and dense darkness of might
Two fireflies are on a boat
Embracing the vast sea.

I`ll wait
Being a handful of dust,
Mixing with a crazy wind,
I`ll wait for you
Secretly behind the lotus petals
Being an anxious sunshine.
